Players Committee card image of [[Make Ten Men Feel Like A Hundred]], as first published (no errata mark), printing: “If Stardust on table, deploy on table. Saw is a Resistance Agent and spy. Once per game, may ▼ Saw. Rebel spies are deploy -1. Once per battle, if you just drew a Rebel spy for destiny, may retrieve 1 Force. Nightfall is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” Uploaded unchanged.
